captions: The bank. Your manager. The delivery guy.
Her name? At the very bottom.
“I'll call her tomorrow.” You said that last week.
She never complains. She just waits.
Tonight, you don't call. You go.
Same table. The food she always makes.
She doesn't say much. But she can't stop smiling.
One hour of your week. The best hour of hers.

verses.text: “So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.”

hook.text: 12 calls this week. Not one to your mother.

end.text: 12 calls this week. Not one to your mother.
